children: The Eurozone flash composite PMI hit a 41-month high of 53.1 in September.
Eurozone services activity expanded at its fastest rate in 10 months, with the Flash Services PMI Business Activity Index rising to 53.0 from 51.6 in August.
Manufacturing output reached a 55-month high as the flash manufacturing output index edged up to 53.4 from 53.3 in the previous month.
The Eurozone Manufacturing PMI held steady at 52.7, matching August's reading and signaling an unchanged pace of growth.
